trials.raw:
I’d start looking for another job now. If I had the energy for one more conversation with my boss, I’d say, “I can take this on, but something else will have to wait. What should I put off?” If they still expected everything done, I’d plan to leave.

I’d also check how long I could cover my bills without a paycheck. That would help me decide whether to quit now or wait for an offer. What’s happened when you’ve pushed back, if you have?
